summary: Phase 146M independently repeated Phase 146I's operational-readiness assessment against the CHGR-001 schema-envelope capability as it stands after Phases 146J/146K/146L/146LV, treating no predecessor phase's own report text as proof. Independently re-read CHGR-001 v1.3 Sec.18/Sec.26/Sec.30 (CHGR-REQ-194 through CHGR-REQ-216) and the full source of verification.py, inspection.py, record.py, and coordinator.py directly. Built two genuine build_publication_record bundles (A, B) through the real installed pcae CLI (decision-session create/evidence/select/preview/confirm/readiness -> governance-record publish) and independently ran a fresh adversarial matrix directly against the deployed verify_artifact_at_path/CLI: confirmation and provenance cross-bundle substitution (record_id rewritten, self-digest recomputed, donor content retained) rejected REFERENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH; integrity cross-bundle substitution rejected DIGEST_MISMATCH via the reciprocal payload_digest binding, confirming rejection is through the directed payload relationship rather than final-digest equality; duplicate-candidate injection (identical, tampered, and cross-family) rejected RELATED_ARTIFACT_AMBIGUOUS/RELATED_ARTIFACT_FAMILY_MISMATCH for all three reference roles regardless of argument order; missing-sibling scenarios explicitly disclosed as skipped, never silently passed; and replay of an already-published package cleanly rejected with no duplicate artifacts. Both of Phase 146I's original Blocking findings (A: duplicate-match ambiguity; C: cross-artifact digest-reference bypass) are independently confirmed closed by this fresh reproduction. Independently built a wheel in a separately provisioned isolated virtual environment (the ambient test environment lacks the build module), confirmed all 15 CHGR schema resource files are present in the built wheel, and confirmed a fresh, installed-only virtual environment can inspect a live artifact fully offline -- establishing that observed ambient packaging-test failures are an environment-provisioning gap, not a missing-resource defect. Reassessed Phase 146I's Finding D (malformed template_ref.version/template_id accepted through four CLI steps, surfaced only as a generic internal_error at publish): reproduced twice with two different malformed fields, unrepaired, unchanged, remains Non-Blocking. Carried-forward NB-1/NB-2/I-1/I-2 findings from Phase 146LV independently reassessed and unchanged. Regression: 223/223 targeted CHGR/publication tests passed, fast_green 4391/4391 passed, broad keyword sweep 4041 passed/10 failed/4 skipped -- all 10 failures independently classified (9 share the identical python -m build environment-provisioning root cause reproduced directly; 1 is a non-reproducible, out-of-scope flake, passing in isolation and alongside its neighbor file, also previously seen and classified in Phase 146LV). No new Blocking finding was discovered. Verdict: OPERATIONALLY READY WITH LIMITATIONS, applying only to the currently authorized CHGR-001 schema-envelope publication/verification role. Full detail in docs/PHASE_146M_CHGR001_SCHEMA_ENVELOPE_OPERATIONAL_READINESS_REASSESSMENT.md.
